instructions: 1. proof-accounts.json names each proof account: an origin and a test address whose mail reaches an AgentMail proof inbox. Codes go to these addresses only.
2. Run the tool with no input (or origins to ask fewer).
3. Keep asked_at from the answer: step keep reads the codes sent after it.
